summary: Linux enforced default asserted as exactly one explicit --host 0.0.0.0 with PANOPTICON_HOST both unset and empty, extracted from inside the real env /bin/sh -c wrapper with non-tmux subprocess calls trapped; disabled-mode loopback and standalone uvicorn host=127.0.0.1 covered by separate tests; end-to-end start/host tests pin the full session argv.
